data.body: **[P1] Do not change the invocation outcome after plugin finalization.** Handler-scope cleanup can report a fatal error after `awaitHandlerScopes` has already emitted `onInvocationEnd`; this check then throws after `ExecutionManager.close()` releases the plugins. The caller consequently observes failure/retry while telemetry permanently records the earlier status. Observe scope failures before invoking end hooks and releasing plugins, or preserve the finalized caller outcome, and assert that the caller result and end-hook snapshot agree.
